patthana18.6:1.1: hetuṃ saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.6:3.1: hetuṃ ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.6:5.1: hetuṃ oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.6:7.1: hetuṃ yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.6:9.1: hetuṃ nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no nīvaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.6:11.1: na hetuṃ parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu no parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
